candidate_response_definition_for_m2_dev.gap_rule: If continuity becomes invalid between event time and target horizon, response is missing for that horizon. No future state may backfill across the gap.
candidate_response_definition_for_m2_dev.positive_means: subsequent midpoint repriced in the direction of the liquidity-pressure change
candidate_response_definition_for_m2_dev.target_state_rule: Use the causally reconstructed p1 state valid as-of the exact target time. The last valid state may persist through target time; do not wait for or select the first future update.

canonical_axis.secondary_token: Polymarket outcomeIndex == 1 (p0), captured for integrity/secondary diagnostics only

continuity_and_reconstruction.reconciliation_mismatch_action: increment book generation, record new full snapshot, and invalidate continuity across the boundary
continuity_and_reconstruction.silence_or_connection_gap_action: invalidate continuity until a new full resync snapshot is recorded

development_and_confirmation_plan.M1: dedicated new capture; engineering/reconstruction feasibility only
development_and_confirmation_plan.M3_if_promising: freeze exact statistic, primary horizon, clustering/declaration rules, sample gate, and prospective OOS confirmation rule
development_and_confirmation_plan.M4_if_frozen: new prospective confirmatory OOS collection and one-time readout
development_and_confirmation_plan.execution_stage_if_confirmed: only after confirmation: executable bid/ask, spread, latency, fees, slippage, queue assumptions, conservative fills, and paper trading

explicit_non_decisions: No minimum imbalance-change magnitude threshold is selected.
No optimal response horizon is selected.
No multi-level depth statistic is selected as the primary H6 signal.
No maker/taker execution choice is made.
No winner or settlement data is required.
No F19 trade content is read.
No H5 response or external-odds data is read.

frame_atomicity.event_time: single local receive timestamp assigned once to the raw frame
frame_atomicity.rule: All p1 changes contained in one raw websocket frame are applied before evaluating the H6 transition for that token. A frame can create at most one primary H6 transition per p1 token.

freeze_time_authority: git commit timestamp; no separate wall-clock freeze timestamp
m0_verdict: NEW HYPOTHESIS FAMILY PREREGISTERED; NO SIGNAL, RESPONSE, OR ECONOMIC CLAIM

m1_engineering_stage.after_fail: Diagnose engineering defects without calculating H6 response. A corrected collector or protocol requires a new preregistered engineering cohort; failed-cohort data remain burned for H6 mechanism evidence.
m1_engineering_stage.after_inconclusive: The frozen H6-M1 cohort remains permanently burned. Any new engineering attempt requires a separately preregistered M1 variant/cohort before acquisition; it may not extend or append to the original cohort based on observed message/transition counts.

engineering_cohort.capture_window_rule: For every registered M1 engineering market, capture the fixed wall-clock interval from exactly 1800 seconds before registered game start until registered game start.

forbidden_metrics: future midpoint change after H6 transition
correlation between imbalance change and future price
regression of future price on imbalance change

important_independence_exception.reason: M1 computes no H6 response or effect. Identity overlap permits immediate feed engineering while the M1 cohort is permanently excluded from all H6 evidence.

m1_engineering_stage.name: H6-M1 dedicated CLOB reconstruction and transition-feasibility

result_semantics.FAIL_ENGINEERING_FEASIBILITY: Any integrity, causality, reconstruction, generation/connection mixing, future-backfill, in-play contamination, raw-frame preservation, deterministic-replay, initial-snapshot, or valid-state coverage gate fails.
result_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE_ENGINEERING: All integrity, causality, reconstruction, and >=95% valid-state coverage gates pass, but the frozen event-density and/or market-breadth gates are not met. Do not extend the same cohort or capture window to chase counts.
result_semantics.PASS_ENGINEERING_FEASIBILITY: All integrity, causality, reconstruction, coverage, and event-density/breadth gates pass on the fixed registered capture windows.

m1_engineering_stage.scope_change_after_m1_failure: A sport/market-type expansion requires a newly preregistered H6 variant and may not silently rescue H6.

success_gates.raw_text_frame_capture: all received text frames preserved with SHA256
success_gates.transition_market_breadth: >= 25 valid transitions in each of at least 4 markets

allowed_only_after: H6-M2 development registry is frozen before data observation
m2_development_stage.data: new post-M1 dedicated H6 data only
required_reporting: continuous relationship between imbalance_change and future midpoint change

name: Endogenous Top-of-Book Liquidity Pressure to Polymarket Repricing

multi_level_depth.allowed_role_before_m3: engineering reconstructability and secondary M2 development diagnostics only

primary_transition_family.liquidity_change_requirement: At least one of best bid displayed size or best ask displayed size changes.
primary_transition_family.reason_no_trade_cancel_classification: The mechanism is displayed-liquidity pressure, not an unsupported inference about whether a size change was caused by cancellation, addition, or execution.
primary_transition_family.unit: one valid p1 pre-frame state to one valid p1 post-frame state

scientific_position.mechanism: Displayed liquidity can reallocate before quoted prices move. A directional change in executable top-of-book depth may reveal endogenous price pressure before the midpoint reprices.
scientific_position.null: Conditional on unchanged contemporaneous best bid/ask prices, changes in top-of-book size imbalance have no systematic relationship with subsequent midpoint changes.
scientific_position.question: When Polymarket best bid and best ask prices are unchanged, does a change in displayed top-of-book size imbalance predict the direction of a subsequent short-horizon midpoint repricing?
